s: Dine happetila vehashshemen ubo t"z seipim: asur laasot petila lenerot shel shabbat middabar shehaur eno neechaz bo veniknas betoko ella nisrak sebibayv vehashshalhebet qopetzet, kegon tzemer, vesear, upishtan sheeno naputz, upesolet shel meshi, vekayyotze bahem, dekevan sheenan doleqim yapeh chosheshim shemma yatteh hanner kede sheyyitqareb meod hashshemen shebbetoko el happetila veyidlaq yapeh, venimtza mabir beshabbat. Abal osim mitztzemer gepen veqannabbus vekayyotze bahem middebarim shehaur neechaz bahem veniknas betokam. Upishta neputza yoter toba mikkullam:

Veim hidliq bidbarim haasurim — asur lehishtammesh leoran shum tashmish baolam, apillu tashmish sheen tzarik iyyun kelal, sheen tzarik lehitqareb etzel hanner bishbilo, dekevan sheenan meirim yapeh chosheshim shemma yatteh hanner ap al pi shemmishtammesh merachoq. Veen chilluq bazeh ben nerot sheal hashshulchan lishar hannerot shebbabbayit o shebbishar kol hachadarim, shekkullan tzerikim lihyot middebarim hammuttarim. Veyesh omerim sheim yesh bemaqom echad ner kasher sheasuy middabar hammuttar, ap al pi sheshshear kol hannerot asuyim middabar haasur — en bekak kelum, apillu im ner hakkasher doleq becheder bipne atzmo, dekevan shehitzrikuhu ner kasher bemaqom echad — yesh lo hekker vezikkaron bazeh velo yabo lehattot. Uletzorek shabbat yesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad, umuttar lehishtammesh leoran. Veim yesh bemaqom echad ner echad kasher veomed etzlo ner pasul — muttar lehishtammesh sham ledibre hakkol bekol inyan, shehare ap im lo haya sham ella ner hakkasher bilbad haya yakol lehishtammesh sham, umah mapsido or ner happasul:

Yesh omerim shekkol dabar sheepshar laasoto belo ner, kegon limshok yayin min hammartep vekayyotze bazeh — muttar laasoto leor ner happasul ap al pi sheen lo shum ner kasher beshum maqom, lepi sheen lachush bazeh shemma yatteh, kevan sheepshar laasot zeh belo ner kelal. Uletzorek shabbat yesh lismok al zeh bediabad:

Im karak dabar shemmuttar lehadliq al dabar sheasur lehadliq bo vaasaan petila achat, im nitkavven bazeh lehaabot happetila kede lehosip orah — asur lehadliqah lener shel shabbat, gezera shemma yabo lehadliq bedabar haasur bilbaddo. Veim nitkavven lehaqshot happetila kede shettehe omedet velo tered lematta — muttar lehadliqah ap al pi sheggam dabar haasur doleq bah. Veim dabar haasur hu dabar sheeno rauy liptila bilbaddo, kegon qash ugemi vekayyotze bahem — muttar likrok alehem dabar hammuttar ulehadliqan, apillu im mitkavven lehaabot happetila kede lehosip orah, lepi sheen lachush shemma yabo lehadliq bedabar haasur bilbaddo, kevan sheen rauy liptila kelal bilbaddo:

Muttar litten gargir shel melach ugeris shel pol al pi hanner beereb shabbat kede sheyyehe doleq yapeh beshabbat, shehammelach vehaggeris tzolelin et hashshemen venimshak yapeh achar happetila, veen bazeh issur bemah sheggorem qetzat habara beshabbat:

Asur lehadliq ner leshabbat, ben ner sheal hashshulchan, ben kol ner shebbabbayit o shebbishar chadarim, mishshemanim sheenam nimshakim achar happetila. Veellu hem, zepet, veshaava, veshemen heasuy mitztzemer gepen, (shuman) alya (ushear shuman), vachalabim sheenan mebushshalim, veqirbe dagim shello nimmochu, dekevan sheenan doleqim yapeh — chosheshim shemma yatteh hanner. Ushear kol hashshemanim nimshakim achar happetila, umadliqin bekullam. Chutz min haitran, mippene sherecho ra, ugezera shemma yannichennu veyetze, vechoba leekol etzel hanner beshabbat. Vechutz min hatztzori, mippene sherecho nodep, gezera shemma yistappeq mimmennu, vehammistappeq mehanner haddoleq yesh bo mishshum mekabbeh, veod mippene shehu ap venidbaq haur bekotle habbayit, veshemma yehe bahul al mamono veyabo lekabbot. Umittaam zeh tzarik lizzaher shello listom hattannur sheyyesh bo esh baetz:

Shemanim sheenam nimshakim achar happetila shennatan letokan shemen zayit kol shehu veaz hem nimshakim achar happetila — ap al pi ken asur lehadliq bahen, gezera shemma yabo lehadliq bahen belo taarobet shemen:

Vecheleb shehittiko veken qirbe dagim shennimmochu shehem nimshakim achar happetila — muttar lehadliqam al yede sheyyitten letokam shemen kol shehu mishshear kol hashshemanim shemmadliqin bahem. Abal belo taarobet shear shemen — en madliqin bahem, gezera shemma yabo lehadliq bahem kesheadayin lo nittoku venimmochu, veaz enam nimshakim, veyesh chashash hattayat hanner, mah sheen ken keshemmadliqam al yede taarobet shear shemen kol shehu, ap im yabo lehadliqam al yede taarobot zeh kesheadayin lo nittoku venimmochu — lo yihyeh sham chashash hattaya, lepi shehem nimshakim achar happetila al yede hashshemen kol shehu:
Shimre shemen apillu shel shemen zayit — en madliqim bahem, mippene sheenan nimshakim achar happetila:
Im abar vehidliq bashshemanim sheasur lehadliq bahem — dino kehidliq bappetilot sheen madliqin bahem, ukemo shennitbaer lemala:

Lo aseru lehadliq bashshemanim sheenam nimshakim ella keshehashshemen eno karuk sebib happetila kemo nerot shellanu, ella munnach kullo bakkeli shehu hanner vetocheb petila betoko, sheaz hu eno nimshak achar happetila. Abal im karak oto sebib happetila, kegon shekkarak zepet o shaava apillu sheeno mehuttak sebib happetila — hare hu nimshak achareha, umuttar lehadliq bo. Umikkol maqom, im asa petila middebarim haasurim vekarak sebibah et hashshaava o et hacheleb apillu hammehuttak — asur lehadliq bah, sheap shehashshemen nimshak achar happetila, mikkol maqom happetila mechamat atzmah enah doleqet yapeh, vechosheshim shemma yatteh:

Ap al pi shekkol hashshemanim chutz meellu shemmanu chakamim kesherim lehadliq bahem lekattechilla — mitzva min hammubchar lehadder achar shemen zayit kemo lener chanukka, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tra"g. Veim en shemen zayit matzuy — mitzva yoter bishar shemanim sheoran zak vetzalul mibbenerot shel cheleb veshel shaava hakkerukim, lepi sheyyesh oserim otan, sheenam mechalleqim ben hashshemen happasul hammunach bikli lakkaruk sebib happetila. Veim tzarik lilmod ballayla leor hanner — yadliq ner karuk velo sheeno karuk, lepi sheetzel hakkaruk yesh hetter lilmod, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ar"h. Umitzva yoter bener shel shaava mibbeshel cheleb, lepi sheoro tzalul yoter:
Hammadliq tzarik sheyyadliq kol kak ad sheyyeechoz haur berob otah chatikat petila hayyotzet min hanner. Veken banner hakkaruk tzarik sheyyeechoz haur berob hayyotze mehakkaruk:

Min haddin en tzarik lehabheb happetila al hashshalhebet qodem sheyyadliqenna kede shettihyeh mechoreket vetadliq yapeh. Abal nahagu hannashim lehadliq happetila ulekabbotah, kede shettihyeh mechoreket qodem shettadliqenna leshem mitzva, kede shetteechoz bah haur yapeh, ben bener shel shemen, ben bener hakkaruk, uminhag yapeh hu:

Semartutin, dehaynu belae bigde pishtan haggassim — en osim otam petila lanner apillu hem mechorakim, lepi sheenam doleqim yapeh. Abal bigde pishtan haddaqqim — madliqim bahem (apillu hem chadashim) ap al pi sheenan mechorakim. Veim chal yom tob beereb shabbat — asur lehadliq bachatikat beged shehi g' etzbaot metzumtzamot lo pachot velo yoter, lepi sheqqodem shemmatchil lehadliqah torat keli aleha leinyan qabbalat tuma, lepi shenniqret beged, umiyyad shehitchil lehadliqah qodem shehidliq rob hayyotze mimmenna chutz lanner nitbattela mittorat keli, shekkevan shennipchata mig' etzbaot enah meqabbelet tuma, sheen shem beged aleha, vahare naaset sheber keli beyom tob, vezehu hanniqra nolad, shennolad beyom tob, vekol nolad asur lehishtammesh bo beyom tob, im ken mah shehu mitasseq lehadliq rob hayyotze mimmenna chutz lanner achar shehitchil lehadliqah — hu oseh issur bezeh, shemmishtammesh benolad beyom tob. Bameh debarim amurim? Keshemmannicham banner kak kemot shehi, shello qippelah kederek sheggodelin petilot, abal im qippelah vegadal mimmenna petila meereb yom tob — muttar lehadliq bah, lepi shekkebar nitbattela mittorat beged leinyan tuma meereb yom tob, veen kan nolad:
En lehadliq bener yashan shel cheres al hashshulchan sheshsham iqqar mitzvat ner shabbat, kemo sheen madliqim bo bachanukka, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tra"g, ayyen sham:
